title_en: [2027 Spring Semester] Electrical Engineering Design Project (Graduation Project) Information
summary: The department announces the schedule for proposing, applying for and assigning Electrical Engineering Design Project (Graduation Project) topics for the 2027 Spring semester, together with the interim and final presentations and the thesis submission. Students should prepare for the graduation project according to this schedule.
applies_to: Students preparing the 2027 Spring semester Electrical Engineering Design Project (Graduation Project). The notice states that all students must take part in the interim presentations.

dates.what: Project topic proposals uploaded by each laboratory (4 weeks)
Project topics posted on the intranet
1st round preference applications by students (7 days)
1st round preference changes (3 days; new applications not allowed)
1st round interviews with professors and paper submission of the Interview Confirmation Form (2 weeks)
3rd round project assignment (assigned after the Interview Confirmation Form with the supervisor's signature is confirmed)
Interim presentations (3 sessions at 2–3 week intervals, one of which is a special lecture on thesis writing; exact dates to be announced on the homepage)
Graduation thesis submission (separate notice to follow)

steps: Check the project topics and apply for your preferences on the intranet: Department homepage > Intranet > Class > Graduation Project Topic Check and Application [학부 홈페이지 > 인트라넷 접속 > 수업 > 졸업프로젝트 과제 확인 및 지망].
Submit your 1st round preferences between 21 October (Wed) and 28 October (Wed).
If needed, change your preferences between 29 October (Thu) and 2 November (Mon). New applications are not allowed during this period.

Between 3 November (Tue) and 17 November (Tue), meet the professor you wish to apply to, then submit the Interview Confirmation Form [면담확인서] on paper to the staff member in charge at Building 301, Room 308 (the office inside the laboratory). The form is in the attached file.
Check the 1st round assignment results on 18 November (Wed).

For the 2nd round: apply 19 November (Thu) – 26 November (Thu), change preferences 27 November (Fri) – 1 December (Tue), hold interviews 2 December (Wed) – 16 December (Wed), and check results on 17 December (Thu).
For the 3rd round assignment (18 December (Fri) – 26 February (Fri)), submit the Interview Confirmation Form signed by your supervising professor; assignment is made after the form is confirmed.
Attend all three interim presentations held during March–May; check the homepage for the exact dates.
Take part in the final poster presentation in the 1st-floor corridor of Building 301 in the last week of May.
Submit your graduation thesis in early to mid-June, following the separate notice to be posted.
translation:
2027 Spring Semester Electrical Engineering Design Project (Graduation Project) Schedule

The schedule for graduation project topic applications and the overall process for the 2027 Spring semester is announced below. Please refer to the schedule below and prepare for the 2027 Spring semester graduation project.

※ Method: Department homepage > Intranet > Class > Graduation Project Topic Check and Application [학부 홈페이지 > 인트라넷 접속 > 수업 > 졸업프로젝트 과제 확인 및 지망]

Assignment stage | Schedule | Duration | Notes

- Topic proposal | 1 Oct (Thu) – 2 Nov (Mon) | 4 weeks | Each laboratory uploads its project topics.
- Topic announcement | Until the interview deadline | – | Posted on the intranet.
- 1st round application | 21 Oct (Wed) – 28 Oct (Wed) | 7 days | Students apply.
- 1st round change | 29 Oct (Thu) – 2 Nov (Mon) | 3 days | New applications are not allowed.
- 1st round interview | 3 Nov (Tue) – 17 Nov (Tue) | 2 weeks | After an interview with the professor you wish to apply to, submit the Interview Confirmation Form [면담확인서] on paper. Form: see the attached document. Office of the staff member in charge: Building 301, Room 308 (the office inside the laboratory).
- 1st round assignment announcement | 18 Nov (Wed) | 1 day
- 2nd round application | 19 Nov (Thu) – 26 Nov (Thu) | 1 week
- 2nd round change | 27 Nov (Fri) – 1 Dec (Tue) | 2 days
- 2nd round interview | 2 Dec (Wed) – 16 Dec (Wed) | 2 weeks
- 2nd round assignment announcement | 17 Dec (Thu) | 1 day
- 3rd round project assignment | 18 Dec (Fri) – 26 Feb (Fri) | 3 months | Assigned after submission of the Interview Confirmation Form is confirmed (the supervising professor's signature is required).
- 4th round project assignment | (no separate date is given in the notice)
- Interim presentations | During March–May, at 2–3 week intervals (one of the 3 sessions is a special lecture on thesis writing) | 3 sessions | All students must participate. Exact dates will be announced on the homepage at the time.
- Final presentation | Last week of May | 1 day | Poster presentation in the 1st-floor corridor of Building 301.
- Graduation thesis submission | Early to mid-June | – | A separate notice will follow.

* For enquiries, please contact the staff member in charge at the department office; the contact details are given in the original Korean notice.

Attachment (1 file): 2027학년도 1학기_면담확인서 양식.hwp (2027 Spring Semester Interview Confirmation Form, 27 KB). The content of this attachment was not read; please download it from the original notice.
